facts.fact: 放逐令传达：Percival 亲口（shame 不闪避）+Nash「It's the only way we can keep the kingdom unified」——流放、Eirene 亲自推动（「She said she had the idea from you」）；「The Rexon blood in my veins is no different than the blood in yours」Percival 深鞠躬
告别四连：Percival 私下授衔「General Theron」（必须留在 cottage 里）；Nash 哭成泪人（「I love you, dear girl. I always will」）；父亲被她勒令发誓（「Swear it!」——不能在她走后再撤退）+「You are my own. You forever will be」；Red（Asmund）被点名叫来

最后演说：不认 Princess of Dranderon（「I do not leave here as Princess of Dranderon…but as an exiled Guard」）；「I ride for men, not kings—I always have」；「Fear me if you must, Arkendrath. I fear none of you. And I will always know you exiled me because you know you are unable to kill me.」——压轴威胁「If you fail to keep my sister safe…I will come back and burn you all alive.」

facts.fact: 部下的真话：Areneas（独眼仍肿）——「他们选流放是因为我们揍了他们：怕处决的后果」；「Then you will adapt! That is an order.」截断 Peltin 的「无法跟随」
facts.anchor: They were worried about what trying an execution would do to them.

facts.fact: Rokin 主动投奔：提着大包求放逐（「You believed in me as a nobody guard…I'll follow you anywhere」）——16 岁最年轻；全员「Welcome, brother…Get in here, Sticks!」

facts.fact: 部下集体跟随：Icarus（「When they exiled you for your blood, they lost my blade, too」）/Fragon（「It's like you said to me before—it's all of us or none of us now」）/Areneas（马厩挨打证明立场）/Blight+Peltin+Hellbore 全体——Seeker 号可载数百人（「That thing is a palace on the sea」）；Alden 不能来、Luminara 要告别
